name: Compensar
body: HSTS, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a sitemap in robots.txt. But CSP frame-ancestors allows *.windows.net and *.core.windows.net, hosts any Azure customer can publish on, so any of them could embed its pages.
lesson: List only the exact origins that embed you in frame-ancestors. Cloud wildcards include strangers.
summary: corporativo.compensar.com scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 53 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 53 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 2 pages ask search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 14 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: 5 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /bico, /salud/plan-complementario/plan-complementario/paga-tu-plan, /salud/, /olimpiadas-fides/historias and 1 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on 11 of 12 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 731 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
